text:
```yaml
name: E2E Windows

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  e2e-windows:
    name: Run E2E tests on Windows
    runs-on: windows-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60
    env:
      SLACK_CHANNEL: '#ci'
      SLACK_USERNAME: 'GitHub Actions'
      SLACK_ICON_EMOJI: ':robot_face:'
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod
          cache-dependency-path: '**/go.sum'

      - name: Install mise
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          go install github.com/jdx/mise@latest
          echo "$env:USERPROFILE\.go\bin" | Out-File -FilePath $env:GITHUB_PATH -Encoding utf8

      - name: Run fmt and lint
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          mise run fmt
          mise run lint

      - name: Run E2E tests
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          mise run test:ci

      - name: Notify Slack on failure
        if: failure()
        uses: slackapi/slack-github-action@v1
        with:
          webhook_url: ${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL }}
          payload: |
            {
              "channel": "${{ env.SLACK_CHANNEL }}",
              "username": "${{ env.SLACK_USERNAME }}",
              "icon_emoji": "${{ env.SLACK_ICON_EMOJI }}",
              "text": ":x: E2E Windows job failed on ${{ github.repository }} - ${{ github.workflow }}.\n<${{ github.server_url }}/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}|View run>"
            }
```
